worksheet.title: Ad Test Worksheet
worksheet.description: Plan your first paid ad test, record the results, and update your Founder Rules with real data.

fields.label: Ad platform
fields.helpText: Which platform will you run your first test on? (e.g. Meta / Facebook & Instagram)

fields.label: Daily budget
fields.helpText: Start with £5–£10/day. Confirm this fits within your monthly cap from Chapter 4.

fields.label: Test duration
fields.helpText: Run for at least 7 days. Write the end date now so you don't stop too early.

fields.label: Target audience
fields.helpText: Describe the audience you'll target. Use your customer profile from Chapter 7: age, location, interests, behaviours.

fields.label: CTR after test
fields.helpText: Click-through rate from your ads dashboard. Fill this in after the test period.

fields.label: CPC after test
fields.helpText: Cost per click. Find in your ads dashboard after the test.

fields.label: Conversion rate after test
fields.helpText: % of ad visitors who purchased. Find in your store analytics or ads dashboard.

fields.label: CPA after test
fields.helpText: Total ad spend ÷ number of sales. The most important number from this test.

fields.label: CPA vs margin
fields.helpText: Compare your CPA to your margin per sale from Chapter 5. Are you acquiring customers profitably? What is the gap?

fields.label: Ad decision
fields.helpText: Based on the results and your Founder Rules.
options: Stop — not profitable enough to continue

fields.label: Updated kill criteria
fields.helpText: Rewrite your kill criteria from Chapter 4 with specific numbers from this test. (e.g. 'Stop if CPA stays above £X for two consecutive weeks')

fields.label: Updated continue criteria
fields.helpText: Rewrite with specific thresholds. (e.g. 'Continue if CPA is trending downward week over week')

fields.label: Updated escalation criteria
fields.helpText: Rewrite with real numbers. (e.g. 'Invest more when CPA is consistently below £X and conversion rate is above Y%')
